beats.headline: Hostile, and fairly so
beats.text: Paz, Anton and I come upon a man and a cat. The cat hisses at me before she is near enough to read my name, and calls me a Havana brown as if it were a diagnosis. So we are not friendly, and I do not apologise for it. It takes some time to clear up. Then we help each other catch our first squad members, monk seals on the beach, because that is what this floor demands, and God does not ask me to like the people I work beside.

beats.headline: Pueblo de los Olvidados
beats.text: The town is corrupted and the quest is mandatory: Pueblo de los Olvidados, the town of the forgotten. Paz is a Santero, and the dead here do not care for that; they wake angry. Ghommids, the whole way out. We run for a saferoom. The man saw something out there, level one hundred and thirty, and thinks it is the boss. It is probably still outside. It cannot hurt us in here. I tell him to open the door.

beats.headline: No more false gods
beats.text: The thing in the straw headdress stands in our saferoom, sick and slowly dying, and asks Paz to repair his shrine. Anton holds a flag, waiting for five per cent. I tell it what it is. A false god. Our souls cannot take this. I tell Anton no. Let Carl's team take him. Anton says it is all make-believe. It is too much. No more false gods. Not again. At about ten per cent the creature opens the door and walks back out into the horde, and it does not come to that.

beats.headline: She will not let Paz go
beats.text: I stand between the god and my men, and he freezes me for it. When I can move again Anton is dead and Paz is dying on the tiles. I tell him to get up, we will get him cured in the club. I tell Carl it is his fault. Paz says not to blame them: he has told them what I am, and what I did. That does not matter now. Get up. Paz says let me go. It is a sin to give up. He says goodbye. Everyone leaves me. I have a flag in my hand, and I put it into his neck, and Paz is a card. A green one.

beats.headline: Out into Havana
beats.text: The goddess Yemaya asks where the other man went. The green card is still in my hand. It goes into my inventory, and I tell her he is not here anymore. Then she calls me brave and gives me a card. When both gods are gone I kneel by Anton and take everything he carried. Then I leave. Carl calls for me to wait. I do not. I walk out through the town, to the cemetery gate, and back into Havana.

beats.headline: It has always been demons
beats.text: The snake is under me, the charm is broken, and a doll's head is fastened to my arm. I tell the man the truth. None of this is real. There are no aliens. It has always been demons, whispering. Hell is open and it is taking us all. I told them not to worship false gods, and they did not listen, before or here. He says they are not real demons either, and asks me to choose them as an ally and leave with them.

beats.headline: No allies
beats.text: The cat's squad chooses me as an ally. I choose no one. They take the ten-second penalty. I summon Paz and put a stout card on him. He begs me, no more. The snake takes him in its mouth, and I tell him to accept his suffering and use his self-destruct skill the moment this false god— Then a neon hand reaches into my cards and plays my Flee. I have lost my key.

beats.headline: She will not let them leave
beats.text: I message the man's party. They are heading for Imani's exit, in the church. I tell them the truth: I cannot let them go into that exit. I can save them, if they come to me. Imani will tell them the church is being overrun by demons, and that the demons are mine. That is also the truth. Both things are true. I did not make this floor. I am only deciding what to do on it.

beats.headline: Amayon fights her control
beats.text: I hold Amayon, prince of Sheol, in the body of a giant snake, and he pulls against me. He is trying to cast; he wants to go home. I do not let go. Around us every exit on this floor is failing at once, and the Demon Eviction is worldwide. This is what I have to set against that. A demon on a leash and my own two hands. God did not give me more.

beats.headline: Asleep in the hallway
beats.text: Sister Ines Quiteria comes down the thirty-second floor hallway at full tilt, glowing, screaming "Sinner!" Crawler Carl's Nighty-Night wand puts her out before she reaches him, and she slides to a stop at his feet with a two-minute timer over her head. Crawler Louis volunteers, since he already carries five player killer skulls and the others carry none. He apologises to her and puts a dagger into her chest. The Reaper of Havana is dead. A god's marked-for-death symbol appears over Crawler Louis.
